people.description: The king in Bezek whose thumbs and great toes Judah cut off, as he had done to threescore and ten kings; he died at Jerusalem (Judges 1:5-7)

people.name: Asherites
people.description: The children of Asher, who dwelt among the Canaanites (Judges 1:31-32)

people.name: Chushan-rishathaim
people.description: King of Mesopotamia, whom Israel served eight years until Othniel prevailed against him (Judges 3:8-10)

people.name: Eglon
people.description: The king of Moab, whom Israel served eighteen years; Ehud slew him (Judges 3:12-25)

people.name: Benjamites
people.description: The men of the tribe of Benjamin (Judges 3:15, 19:16, 20:35)

people.name: Ehud
people.description: The son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded, raised up to deliver Israel; he slew Eglon king of Moab (Judges 3:15-30)

people.name: Gera
people.description: The father of Ehud, a Benjamite (Judges 3:15)

people.name: Anath
people.description: The father of Shamgar (Judges 3:31, 5:6)

people.name: Shamgar
people.description: The son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad; he also delivered Israel (Judges 3:31, 5:6)

people.name: Jabin
people.description: King of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor, who oppressed Israel twenty years; God subdued him before Israel (Judges 4:2-3, 4:23-24)

people.name: Sisera
people.description: The captain of the host of Jabin king of Canaan, which dwelt in Harosheth; Jael slew him with a nail of the tent (Judges 4:2, 4:21, 5:26)

people.name: Deborah
people.description: A prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, who judged Israel and sang with Barak (Judges 4:4-14, 5:1-15)

people.name: Lapidoth
people.description: The husband of Deborah the prophetess (Judges 4:4)

people.name: Abinoam
people.description: The father of Barak (Judges 4:6, 5:1)

people.name: Barak
people.description: The son of Abinoam out of Kedesh-naphtali, whom Deborah called to go against Sisera; he sang with her (Judges 4:6-16, 5:1)

people.name: Heber
people.description: The Kenite, of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, husband of Jael (Judges 4:11, 4:17)

line.note: "Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab"

people.name: Jael
people.description: The wife of Heber the Kenite, who slew Sisera with a nail of the tent; "Blessed above women shall Jael ... be" (Judges 4:17-22, 5:24-27)

people.name: Abi-ezer
people.description: The family of Joash and Gideon, gathered after Gideon (Judges 6:11, 6:24, 6:34, 8:2, 8:32)

people.name: Gideon
people.description: The son of Joash the Abi-ezrite, whom the Lord sent to save Israel from the Midianites; his father called him Jerubbaal (Judges 6:11-14, 6:32, 7:1)

people.name: Joash
people.description: The Abi-ezrite, the father of Gideon; he would not give up his son to the men of the city (Judges 6:11, 6:29-31, 8:32)

people.name: Phurah
people.description: Gideon's servant, who went down with him to the host of Midian (Judges 7:10-11)

people.name: Oreb
people.description: A prince of the Midianites, slain upon the rock Oreb (Judges 7:25, 8:3)

people.name: Zeeb
people.description: A prince of the Midianites, slain at the winepress of Zeeb (Judges 7:25, 8:3)

people.name: Zalmunna
people.description: A king of Midian, taken and slain by Gideon (Judges 8:5-21)

people.name: Zebah
people.description: A king of Midian, taken and slain by Gideon (Judges 8:5-21)

people.name: Jether
people.description: The firstborn of Gideon, who feared to slay Zebah and Zalmunna, because he was yet a youth (Judges 8:20)

people.name: Ishmaelites
people.description: The Midianites had golden earrings, "because they were Ishmaelites" (Judges 8:24)

people.name: Abimelech
people.description: The son of Gideon by his concubine in Shechem; he slew his seventy brethren and reigned three years, and a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon his head at Thebez (Judges 8:31, 9:1-6, 9:53-56)

people.name: Jotham
people.description: The youngest son of Jerubbaal, who escaped Abimelech and spake the parable of the trees from mount Gerizim (Judges 9:5-21, 9:57)

people.name: Ebed
people.description: The father of Gaal (Judges 9:26)

people.name: Gaal
people.description: The son of Ebed, in whom the men of Shechem put their confidence against Abimelech (Judges 9:26-41)

people.name: Zebul
people.description: The ruler of the city of Shechem, Abimelech's officer (Judges 9:28, 9:30)

people.name: Dodo
people.description: A man of Issachar, grandfather of Tola (Judges 10:1)

people.name: Puah
people.description: The son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, father of Tola (Judges 10:1)

people.name: Tola
people.description: The son of Puah, a man of Issachar, who arose to defend Israel and judged Israel twenty and three years (Judges 10:1-2)

people.name: Gileadites
people.description: The men of Gilead under Jephthah, who smote Ephraim (Judges 12:4-5); Jair and Jephthah are called Gileadites (Judges 10:3, 11:1)

people.name: Jair
people.description: A Gileadite, who judged Israel twenty and two years; he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts (Judges 10:3-5)

people.name: Maonites
people.description: Who oppressed Israel (Judges 10:12)

people.name: Gilead
people.description: The father of Jephthah by an harlot; his wife bare him sons, who thrust out Jephthah (Judges 11:1-2)

people.name: Jephthah
people.description: The Gileadite, a mighty man of valour, the son of Gilead by an harlot; he judged Israel six years, and offered his daughter according to his vow (Judges 11:1, 11:29-40, 12:7)

people.name: Ibzan
people.description: Of Beth-lehem; he had thirty sons and thirty daughters, and judged Israel seven years (Judges 12:8-10)

people.name: Elon
people.description: A Zebulonite, who judged Israel ten years and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun (Judges 12:11-12)

people.name: Abdon
people.description: The son of Hillel the Pirathonite, who judged Israel eight years (Judges 12:13-15)

people.name: Hillel
people.description: A Pirathonite, the father of Abdon (Judges 12:13, 12:15)

people.name: Pirathonite
people.description: Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite (Judges 12:13, 12:15)

people.name: Danites
people.description: The tribe of Dan, which sought an inheritance and took Laish (Judges 13:2, 18:1, 18:11)

line.note: "the tribe of the Danites"; "the children of Dan" (18:2)

people.name: Manoah
people.description: A man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, father of Samson, to whom the angel of the Lord appeared (Judges 13:2-23, 16:31)

people.name: Samson
people.description: The son of Manoah, a Nazarite unto God from the womb; he judged Israel twenty years, and died with the Philistines at the house of Dagon (Judges 13:24, 15:20, 16:30-31)

people.name: Timnite
people.description: Samson was the son in law of the Timnite (Judges 15:6)

people.name: Gazites
people.description: The men of Gaza (Judges 16:2)

people.name: Delilah
people.description: The woman in the valley of Sorek whom Samson loved, who delivered him to the Philistines (Judges 16:4-21)

people.name: Micah
people.description: A man of mount Ephraim who made a graven image and a house of gods, and hired a Levite to be his priest (Judges 17:1-13, 18:13-26)

people.name: Gershom
people.description: The son of Manasseh, father of Jonathan the priest of the tribe of Dan (Judges 18:30)

father.note: "Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh": the KJV reading, kept

people.name: Jonathan
people.description: The son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh; he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan (Judges 18:30)

people.name: Manasseh
people.description: The father of Gershom, grandfather of Jonathan the priest of the tribe of Dan (Judges 18:30)

children.note: "Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh": the KJV reading, kept

people.name: Chilion
people.description: A son of Elimelech and Naomi; he died in Moab (Ruth 1:2-5, 4:9)

people.name: Elimelech
people.description: An Ephrathite of Beth-lehem-judah, the husband of Naomi, who went to sojourn in Moab and died there (Ruth 1:1-3)

people.name: Ephrathites
people.description: "Ephrathites of Beth-lehem-judah" (Ruth 1:2)

people.name: Mahlon
people.description: A son of Elimelech and Naomi, the husband of Ruth; he died in Moab (Ruth 1:2-5, 4:10)

partners.note: "Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon"

people.name: Naomi
people.description: The wife of Elimelech, mother of Mahlon and Chilion; she returned from Moab with Ruth and said, Call me Mara (Ruth 1:2-22)

people.name: Orpah
people.description: A woman of Moab, wife of one of Naomi's sons, who kissed her mother in law and returned to her people (Ruth 1:4, 1:14-15)

people.name: Ruth
people.description: The Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, who clave unto Naomi: "thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God"; Boaz took her to wife and she bare Obed (Ruth 1:4, 1:16, 4:10, 4:13)

partners.note: "Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon"

people.name: Boaz
people.description: A mighty man of wealth of Beth-lehem, a kinsman of Elimelech, who redeemed the inheritance and took Ruth to wife; the son of Salmon, father of Obed (Ruth 2:1, 4:9-13, 4:21)

people.name: David
people.description: The son of Jesse, son of Obed (Ruth 4:17, 4:22)

children.note: "Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name was Tamar"

people.name: Jesse
people.description: The son of Obed, father of David (Ruth 4:17, 4:22)

people.name: Obed
people.description: The son of Boaz and Ruth, nursed by Naomi; the father of Jesse, the father of David (Ruth 4:13-17, 4:21-22)

people.name: Ram
people.description: The son of Hezron, father of Amminadab (Ruth 4:19)

people.name: Salmon
people.description: The son of Nahshon, father of Boaz (Ruth 4:20-21)

people.name: Elihu
people.description: The son of Tohu, father of Jeroham (1 Samuel 1:1)

people.name: Elkanah
people.description: The son of Jeroham of Ramathaim-zophim, an Ephrathite; the husband of Hannah and Peninnah, father of Samuel (1 Samuel 1:1-2, 1:19-20, 2:11)

children.note: "Elkanah knew Hannah his wife ... she bare a son, and called his name Samuel"

people.name: Jeroham
people.description: The son of Elihu, father of Elkanah (1 Samuel 1:1)

people.name: Tohu
people.description: The son of Zuph, father of Elihu (1 Samuel 1:1)

people.name: Zuph
people.description: An Ephrathite, father of Tohu, forefather of Elkanah (1 Samuel 1:1)

people.name: Hannah
people.description: The wife of Elkanah, who prayed for a son and vowed him to the Lord; she bare Samuel (1 Samuel 1:2-28, 2:1-10, 2:21)

people.name: Peninnah
people.description: The wife of Elkanah, who had children and provoked Hannah (1 Samuel 1:2-6)

people.name: Eli
people.description: The priest at Shiloh, who judged Israel forty years, father of Hophni and Phinehas (1 Samuel 1:3, 1:9, 4:11-18)

people.name: Hophni
people.description: A son of Eli, priest at Shiloh, slain when the ark was taken (1 Samuel 1:3, 2:34, 4:11)

people.name: Phinehas
people.description: A son of Eli, priest at Shiloh, slain when the ark was taken; father of Ahitub and I-chabod (1 Samuel 1:3, 4:11, 4:19-21, 14:3)

people.name: Samuel
people.description: The son of Elkanah and Hannah, lent to the Lord; prophet and judge of Israel, who anointed Saul and David (1 Samuel 1:20, 3:20, 7:15, 10:1, 16:13)

father.note: "Elkanah knew Hannah his wife ... she bare a son, and called his name Samuel"

people.name: Beth-shemite
people.description: Of Beth-shemesh: "Joshua, a Beth-shemite" (1 Samuel 6:14, 6:18)

people.name: Joshua
people.description: A Beth-shemite, into whose field the cart with the ark came (1 Samuel 6:14, 6:18)

people.name: Abinadab
people.description: Of Kirjath-jearim, in whose house on the hill the ark abode; father of Eleazar (1 Samuel 7:1)

children.note: "Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab"
"Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab"

people.name: Eleazar
people.description: The son of Abinadab, sanctified to keep the ark (1 Samuel 7:1)

people.name: Abiah
people.description: The second son of Samuel, a judge in Beer-sheba (1 Samuel 8:1-3)

people.name: Joel
people.description: The firstborn of Samuel, a judge in Beer-sheba (1 Samuel 8:1-3)

people.name: Abiel
people.description: The son of Zeror, father of Kish and of Ner (1 Samuel 9:1, 14:51)

people.name: Aphiah
people.description: A Benjamite, father of Bechorath (1 Samuel 9:1)

people.name: Bechorath
people.description: The son of Aphiah, father of Zeror (1 Samuel 9:1)

people.name: Kish
people.description: A man of Benjamin, a mighty man of power, the son of Abiel, father of Saul (1 Samuel 9:1-3, 14:51)

people.name: Zeror
people.description: The son of Bechorath, father of Abiel (1 Samuel 9:1)

people.name: Saul
people.description: The son of Kish, a Benjamite, the first king of Israel, anointed by Samuel; rejected by the Lord, he fell upon his sword in mount Gilboa (1 Samuel 9:1-2, 10:1, 15:23, 31:4)

partners.note: "Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah"

line.note: "the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken"

people.name: Matri
people.description: The family of Benjamin of which Saul was taken by lot (1 Samuel 10:21)

people.name: Nahash
people.description: The Ammonite, who encamped against Jabesh-gilead and was smitten by Saul (1 Samuel 11:1-11, 12:12)

people.name: Bedan
people.description: Named with Jerubbaal, Jephthah and Samuel among those the Lord sent to deliver Israel (1 Samuel 12:11)

people.name: Jonathan
people.description: The son of Saul, who smote the Philistines' garrison and loved David as his own soul; slain in mount Gilboa (1 Samuel 13:3, 14:1, 18:1-3, 31:2)

people.name: Ahiah
people.description: The son of Ahitub, I-chabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, wearing an ephod (1 Samuel 14:3, 14:18)

people.name: Ahitub
people.description: The son of Phinehas, son of Eli, brother of I-chabod; father of Ahiah and Ahimelech (1 Samuel 14:3, 22:9, 22:20)

people.name: Ishui
people.description: A son of Saul (1 Samuel 14:49)

same.note: Saul's son: "Ish-bosheth the son of Saul" (2 Samuel 2:8) is "Ishui" in the list of Saul's sons (1 Samuel 14:49); he alone of them outlived Gilboa (1 Samuel 31:2)

sources.title: Jewish Encyclopedia (1901-1906) vol. 6 pp. 656-657, "Ish-bosheth": "as in I Sam. xiv. 49, by making some other substitution (\"Ishui\" ... for \"Ish-ba'al\")"

people.name: Melchi-shua
people.description: A son of Saul, slain by the Philistines in mount Gilboa (1 Samuel 14:49, 31:2)

people.name: Merab
people.description: The elder daughter of Saul, promised to David but given to Adriel the Meholathite (1 Samuel 14:49, 18:17-19)

people.name: Michal
people.description: The younger daughter of Saul, who loved David and was given him to wife; Saul gave her to Phalti (1 Samuel 14:49, 18:20-28, 19:11-17, 25:44)

people.name: Abner
people.description: The son of Ner, Saul's uncle, the captain of Saul's host (1 Samuel 14:50-51, 17:55, 26:5)

people.name: Ahimaaz
people.description: The father of Ahinoam, Saul's wife (1 Samuel 14:50)

people.name: Ahinoam
people.description: The wife of Saul, the daughter of Ahimaaz (1 Samuel 14:50)

people.name: Ner
people.description: The son of Abiel, father of Abner, Saul's uncle (1 Samuel 14:50-51)

people.name: Agag
people.description: The king of the Amalekites, whom Saul spared and Samuel hewed in pieces (1 Samuel 15:8-9, 15:32-33)

people.name: Beth-lehemite
people.description: Of Beth-lehem: "Jesse the Beth-lehemite" (1 Samuel 16:1, 16:18, 17:58)

people.name: Eliab
people.description: The firstborn of Jesse, who went to the battle with Saul (1 Samuel 16:6, 17:13, 17:28)

people.name: Abinadab
people.description: The second son of Jesse (1 Samuel 16:8, 17:13)

people.name: Shammah
people.description: The third son of Jesse (1 Samuel 16:9, 17:13)

people.name: Goliath
people.description: The champion of the Philistines, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span; David slew him with a sling and a stone (1 Samuel 17:4, 17:49-51)

people.name: Adriel
people.description: The Meholathite, to whom Merab was given (1 Samuel 18:19)

people.name: Meholathite
people.description: "Adriel the Meholathite" (1 Samuel 18:19)

people.name: Ahimelech
people.description: The priest at Nob, the son of Ahitub, who gave David the hallowed bread; Doeg slew him at Saul's word (1 Samuel 21:1-9, 22:9-18)

people.name: Doeg
people.description: An Edomite, the chiefest of Saul's herdmen, who slew the priests of Nob (1 Samuel 21:7, 22:9, 22:18)

people.name: Achish
people.description: The son of Maoch, king of Gath, to whom David fled (1 Samuel 21:10-15, 27:2, 29:2-10)

people.name: Abiathar
people.description: The son of Ahimelech, who escaped from Nob and fled after David with an ephod (1 Samuel 22:20, 23:6, 30:7)

people.name: Ziphites
people.description: The men of Ziph, who told Saul where David hid (1 Samuel 23:19, 26:1)

people.name: Abigail
people.description: The wife of Nabal, a woman of good understanding; after Nabal died she became David's wife (1 Samuel 25:3, 25:39-42, 27:3)

people.name: Nabal
people.description: A man of Maon, very great, but churlish, of the house of Caleb; the husband of Abigail; the Lord smote him that he died (1 Samuel 25:2-3, 25:38)

people.name: Ahinoam
people.description: Of Jezreel, a wife of David (1 Samuel 25:43, 27:3, 30:5)

people.name: Laish
people.description: Of Gallim, the father of Phalti (1 Samuel 25:44)

people.name: Phalti
people.description: The son of Laish of Gallim, to whom Saul gave Michal (1 Samuel 25:44)

people.name: Abishai
people.description: The son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, who went with David into Saul's camp by night (1 Samuel 26:6-9)

people.name: Ahimelech
people.description: The Hittite, with David in the wilderness (1 Samuel 26:6)

people.name: Joab
people.description: The son of Zeruiah, brother of Abishai (1 Samuel 26:6)

mother.note: "Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab"

people.name: Zeruiah
people.description: The mother of Abishai and Joab (1 Samuel 26:6); a sister of David (1 Chronicles 2:16)

children.note: "Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab"
"three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel"

people.name: Maoch
people.description: The father of Achish king of Gath (1 Samuel 27:2)

people.name: Carmelite
people.description: Of Carmel: "Abigail the Carmelitess", "Nabal the Carmelite" (1 Samuel 27:3, 30:5)

people.name: Jezreelitess
people.description: "Ahinoam the Jezreelitess" (1 Samuel 27:3, 30:5)

people.name: Gezrites
people.description: A nation David invaded, of old the inhabitants of the land (1 Samuel 27:8)

people.name: Jerahmeelites
people.description: In the south, whose cities David sent of the spoil to (1 Samuel 27:10, 30:29)

people.name: Cherethites
people.description: Whose south the Amalekites invaded (1 Samuel 30:14)

people.name: Abinadab
people.description: A son of Saul, slain by the Philistines in mount Gilboa (1 Samuel 31:2)

people.name: Ish-bosheth
people.description: The son of Saul, whom Abner made king over Israel at Mahanaim; he reigned two years and was slain by Rechab and Baanah (2 Samuel 2:8-10, 4:5-8)

same.note: Saul's son: "Ish-bosheth the son of Saul" (2 Samuel 2:8) is "Ishui" in the list of Saul's sons (1 Samuel 14:49); he alone of them outlived Gilboa (1 Samuel 31:2)

sources.title: Jewish Encyclopedia (1901-1906) vol. 6 pp. 656-657, "Ish-bosheth": "as in I Sam. xiv. 49, by making some other substitution (\"Ishui\" ... for \"Ish-ba'al\")"

people.name: Ashurites
people.description: Over whom Abner made Ish-bosheth king (2 Samuel 2:9)

people.name: Asahel
people.description: A son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab and Abishai, light of foot, slain by Abner; one of the thirty (2 Samuel 2:18-23, 3:30, 23:24)

mother.note: "three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel"

people.name: Amnon
people.description: The firstborn of David, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, who forced his sister Tamar and was slain by Absalom's servants (2 Samuel 3:2, 13:1-29)

people.name: Absalom
people.description: The third son of David, of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; he slew Amnon, rose against his father, and was slain by Joab (2 Samuel 3:3, 13:28-29, 15:10, 18:14-15)

same.note: "Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom" (1 Kings 15:2) is "Maachah the daughter of Absalom" (2 Chronicles 11:20-21)

sources.title: Josephus, Antiquities of the Jews 8.10.1 (Whiston): Rehoboam "married also another of his own kindred, who was daughter of Absalom by Tamar, whose name was Maachah"
Josephus, Antiquities 7.10.3: Absalom's daughter Tamar "married to David's grandson, Rehoboam"
Jewish Encyclopedia (1901-1906) vol. 8 p. 233, "Maacah" no. 4

people.name: Chileab
people.description: The second son of David, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite (2 Samuel 3:3)

people.name: Maacah
people.description: The daughter of Talmai king of Geshur, mother of Absalom (2 Samuel 3:3)

people.name: Talmai
people.description: The son of Ammihud, king of Geshur, father of Maacah; Absalom fled to him (2 Samuel 3:3, 13:37)

people.name: Abital
people.description: The mother of Shephatiah, David's son born in Hebron (2 Samuel 3:4)

people.name: Adonijah
people.description: The fourth son of David, the son of Haggith (2 Samuel 3:4)

people.name: Haggith
people.description: The mother of Adonijah, David's son born in Hebron (2 Samuel 3:4)

people.name: Shephatiah
people.description: The fifth son of David, the son of Abital (2 Samuel 3:4)

people.name: Eglah
people.description: David's wife, mother of Ithream (2 Samuel 3:5)

people.name: Ithream
people.description: The sixth son of David, by Eglah David's wife (2 Samuel 3:5)

people.name: Aiah
people.description: The father of Rizpah (2 Samuel 3:7, 21:8, 21:10-11)

people.name: Rizpah
people.description: Saul's concubine, the daughter of Aiah, mother of Armoni and Mephibosheth; she kept the bodies of her sons on the rock (2 Samuel 3:7, 21:8-11)

partners.note: "Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah"

people.name: Baanah
people.description: A son of Rimmon the Beerothite, captain of a band under Ish-bosheth; with Rechab he slew Ish-bosheth (2 Samuel 4:2-12)

people.name: Beerothites
people.description: Of Beeroth, reckoned to Benjamin; they fled to Gittaim (2 Samuel 4:2-3, 23:37)

people.name: Rechab
people.description: A son of Rimmon the Beerothite, captain of a band under Ish-bosheth; with Baanah he slew Ish-bosheth (2 Samuel 4:2-12)

people.name: Rimmon
people.description: A Beerothite of the children of Benjamin, father of Baanah and Rechab (2 Samuel 4:2, 4:5, 4:9)

people.name: Mephibosheth
people.description: The son of Jonathan the son of Saul, lame of his feet from five years old; David restored him Saul's land and he ate at the king's table; father of Micha (2 Samuel 4:4, 9:6-13, 16:1-4, 19:24-30, 21:7)

line.note: "the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul"

people.name: Hiram
people.description: King of Tyre, who sent cedar trees, carpenters and masons to build David an house (2 Samuel 5:11)

people.name: Nathan
people.description: A son of David born in Jerusalem (2 Samuel 5:14)

people.name: Shammua
people.description: A son of David born in Jerusalem (2 Samuel 5:14)

people.name: Shobab
people.description: A son of David born in Jerusalem (2 Samuel 5:14)

people.name: Solomon
people.description: A son of David born in Jerusalem, of Bath-sheba; the Lord loved him, and called him Jedidiah by Nathan (2 Samuel 5:14, 12:24-25)

people.name: Elishua

people.description: The chief priest, taken by the captain of the guard and slain at Riblah (2 Kings 25:18-21)

people.name: Zephaniah
people.description: The second priest, taken by the captain of the guard and slain at Riblah (2 Kings 25:18-21)

people.name: Gedaliah
people.description: The son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, made ruler over the people left in Judah; slain by Ishmael at Mizpah (2 Kings 25:22-25)

people.name: Careah
people.description: The father of Johanan (2 Kings 25:23)

people.name: Ishmael
people.description: The son of Nethaniah, of the seed royal, who smote Gedaliah at Mizpah (2 Kings 25:23-25)

people.name: Jaazaniah
people.description: The son of a Maachathite, a captain who came to Gedaliah (2 Kings 25:23)

people.name: Johanan
people.description: The son of Careah, a captain who came to Gedaliah (2 Kings 25:23)

people.name: Nethaniah
people.description: The son of Elishama, the father of Ishmael (2 Kings 25:23, 25:25)

people.name: Seraiah
people.description: The son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, a captain who came to Gedaliah (2 Kings 25:23)

people.name: Tanhumeth
people.description: The Netophathite, the father of Seraiah (2 Kings 25:23)

people.name: Elishama
people.description: Of the seed royal, the grandfather of Ishmael (2 Kings 25:25)

people.name: Evil-merodach
people.description: King of Babylon, who lifted up the head of Jehoiachin out of prison (2 Kings 25:27-30)
